llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must run animation-critical computation in UI-runtime worklets (for example `useDerivedValue`/worklet functions) over shared values.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Animation logic runs inside a plain worklet function dispatched via runOnUI, not via useDerivedValue or a reaction over shared values. No useSharedValue/useDerivedValue is used anywhere.
evidence: No import or usage of useSharedValue, useDerivedValue, or useAnimatedReaction

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must dispatch start/stop or control worklet functions from React runtime using `scheduleOnUI(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnUI`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Dispatching to the UI thread uses the deprecated runOnUI instead of the required scheduleOnUI from react-native-worklets.
evidence: App.tsx: runOnUI(...) used in startProgressOnUI useMemo

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must bridge UI-runtime checkpoint updates back to React via `scheduleOnRN(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Bridging back to the React runtime uses the deprecated runOnJS instead of the required scheduleOnRN from react-native-worklets.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must gate `scheduleOnRN(...)` behind explicit bucket/checkpoint logic in a UI worklet reaction (for example `useAnimatedReaction`) instead of calling it every frame.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Although checkpoint updates are gated on nextCheckpoint > lastCheckpoint (bucket logic), the bridge call is still made with deprecated runOnJS rather than scheduleOnRN, and there is no useAnimatedReaction wrapping the gating logic as required.
evidence: No useAnimatedReaction present in the file
